summary.text: Stephanie Carkin is the Republican and Libertarian Party candidate for the Oregon House of Representatives, District 26, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in a race that also includes incumbent Sue Rieke Smith (D) and Steph Terrio (Pacific Green Party of Oregon, Progressive Party).
Carkin advanced from the Republican primary on May 19, 2026.
